name: AzuraCast
description: Admin web-update spins up a Watchtower sidecar that pulls a fresh Docker image with no app-level signature check.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: AzuraCast triggers an internal updater over plaintext HTTP; image retrieval and integrity are delegated to Docker.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | AzuraCast | https://github.com/AzuraCast/AzuraCast | 2cb84e2 / 2026-08-19 | Y | N (admin clicks "update" in web UI; underlying Watchtower sidecar could also poll on its own schedule, not exercised by this app code) | Y (triggers Watchtower to pull a new Docker image & restart containers = new code executed) | app→sidecar leg is plaintext HTTP over the internal docker network (`http://updater:8080`, not internet-exposed); the actual image pull is done by Docker's own registry client (HTTPS, TLS enforced by Docker, not by this codebase) | N (no Docker Content Trust / cosign / notation references anywhere in repo) | none (app-level: no hash/signature check of the pulled image; relies entirely on Docker's default, unauthenticated-content registry pull) | server-supplied/unpinned (whatever image is served by the configured registry over TLS; no pinned digest/key) | `backend/src/Service/WebUpdater.php:37-64` (`ping()`/`triggerUpdate()` → `http://updater:8080/v1/update` with hardcoded bearer token `azur4c457`); `backend/src/Controller/Api/Admin/Updates/PutUpdatesAction.php:36`; `docker-compose.sample.yml:20` (`com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.scope=azuracast`); version-check (notify only) via HTTPS in `backend/src/Service/AzuraCastCentral.php:33-70` (`POST https://central.azuracast.com/api/update`) |
